author: SpicyTunaRoll9
body:
Level 40
Leather Armor 
Stone Sword
2 Claymores (Pressure Plates)

This is like Kit Engineer, but with an added twist.
Put these pressure plates down to set down a trap! The moment an enemy walks over the pressure plate a 1 second timer will be initiated before detonating.
